altdir.description: Directory containing alternative group entries (e.g., /var/lib/alternatives). Matches --altdir option.

admindir.description: Directory containing administrative information for alternatives (e.g., /var/lib/dpkg/alternatives). Matches --admindir option.

cli_options.description: List of CLI option overrides to apply (e.g., for --debug or --normal). Each item must be a flat object with 'option' and 'value'. Optional if option has no argument (e.g., --debug). Use empty string for flag options like --normal or --debug. See galternatives(1).

log_file.description: Path to log file for wrapper/script use. Matches --log LOG option semantics.
